the_two_problems_the_route_probe_had_bef: FIRST ATTEMPT measured HTTP 000 on all four: the probe had been placed AFTER the boot was terminated ('Stop the boot before the isolation checks'), so it was knocking on a closed port. Moved before the shutdown.
the run that found it was ALSO the one where the bun bootstrap finally worked, so two fixes landed together and the log shows them separately.
the_bun_bootstrap_saga_three_real_fixes: the official script fetches from GITHUB RELEASES and this environment's route there is intermittent (`curl: (56)`, then `curl: (28) ... after 135500 ms`) while registry.npmjs.org answered 200 in under a second. Added `npm i -g bun` as a fallback and made `fact bun` NAME THE ROUTE.

the first fallback NEVER FIRED: `run_step ... || { ... }` cannot work, because run_step returns the append's status rather than the child's — its own contract is 'never abort (the verdict is the report's)'. It now tests the STEP_CODE global.

`npm i -g bun` exited 0 and installed NOTHING RUNNABLE: npm refuses dependency install scripts by default (`npm warn allow-scripts bun@1.4.2 (postinstall: node install.js)`) and that postinstall is what downloads the binary. Fixed with `--allow-scripts=bun`, and the binary is now RESOLVED BY SEARCH rather than by guessing its layout — two guessed paths had already left `bun --version` empty while the install reported success.
how_the_credential_travelled: `-e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` WITH NO VALUE, so compose read it from the driver's environment and the secret never entered the echoed argv. The container wrote it into the SANDBOX home's credentials document (mode 0600) and deleted it after the turn. AGENTS.md §10 held throughout: never committed, never logged, never echoed.
not_claimed: the teammate that was raised did not itself run a turn — the assertion is that the executor minted its handle, which is precisely W2's claim
